data.name: Querida
data.gender_notes: Querida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of endearment, derived from the Latin word ‘queriare,’ meaning ‘to seek’ or ‘to love.’ In Christian tradition, Querida represents the deep affection and devotion one has for another. The name Querida carries the meaning “Dear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Querida usually hope their child will grow to embody dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of the love and affection God has for His children.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Querida total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קוירידה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קוירידה נגזר מהמילה הספרדית 'querida', שפירושה אהובה או חביבה. אין לו שורשים עבריים ישירים, אך הוא משקף את האהבה והחיבה שנותן ה' לאדם. השם קושר את הנושא שלו לאהבת ה' הנצחית.

in_greek.name: Κουερίδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κουερίδα προέρχεται από τη Λατινική λέξη 'querida', που σημαίνει αγαπημένη. Αν και δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στη Βίβλο ή στην αρχαία Εκκλησία, το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά την αγάπη και τη στοργή του Θεού για την ανθρωπότητα. Στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Εκκλησίας, τα ονόματα που εκφράζουν την αγάπη του Θεού είναι ιδιαίτερα σημαντικά.

in_latin.name: Querida
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Querida ex Latino 'querida' oritur, quod 'amata' seu 'dilecta' significat. Quamquam in Ecclesia primitiva non invenitur, reflectit tamen amore Dei erga homines. In traditione Christiana, nomina quae amore et gratia Dei referuntur, magna aestimatione habentur.

historical_references.reference: Querida was the name of a 5th century Roman Christian woman who was a noted ascetic and philanthropist. She was known for her devotion to St. Peter, and her generosity to the poor. Her name means 'dear one' or 'beloved' in Latin.

Querida is also the name of a 13th century Spanish saint, Quiteria of Burgos. She was a recluse and lived in a cell near the town of Burgos. She was well known for her visions and miracles, and was particularly venerated for her aid to travelers.
